title: Bats
text:
Bats are the only mammals that can fly. They have wings made of thin skin.

Most bats sleep in the day. They hang upside down in caves or trees. At night, they wake up and look for food.

Bats cannot see well in the dark. Instead, they make high sounds. The sounds hit things and bounce back. This tells the bat where things are.

Some bats eat insects. Other bats eat fruit. A fruit bat helps plants too. When it eats a fruit, it drops the seeds, and new trees can grow.
